title: review/v1
description: targets/<id>/review/review.yaml (F26-R1, R2; D-9 v3.39): the opening of a target's formalization review — the conjecture in words, the proposer's cases, the concepts a candidate must name as predicates (the format rule), who opened it in which role, and where the review is tracked. One per root version: a D-8 revision of the root opens a new review whose record names the old. Append-only; everything else about the review is derived from its other records (candidates, tests, questions, answers, pairs, exhibits, signatures) and never written here. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

target.description: the target the record is filed under

identity.description: the ledger identity or login that opened the review; `network` for the background review of an existing target

role.description: the role the opener acted in; policy.json's review_openers lists the roles allowed, and `network` is the background review the gate opens on every existing target (D-9 v3.39)

words.description: the conjecture in words, as proposed or as the source states it (for an Erdős problem, the erdosproblems.com statement), verbatim

cases.description: what the proposer gave that pins the conjecture down: known special cases, small values, consequences, non-examples; may be empty

text.description: the case in words, with a citation where it has one

concepts.description: the concepts the words use that every candidate must name as its own predicate (F26-R5: `prime`, `divides`, …); a candidate that writes one inline is returned

kind.description: where the review's first candidate comes from: a proposal in words (none), a registry statement (D-10) ported as the first candidate, or the live statement of an existing target

ref.description: the proposal's pull request or issue, the registry entry, or the node id

tracking.description: the graph repository's tracking issue or pull request the App's notices go to (`issue:<n>` or `pr:<n>`); null until one exists (F26-R15)

supersedes.description: the review record this one replaces after a D-8 revision of the root (`review.yaml` of the superseded root's version), else null

id.description: the record's id, lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens; a candidate's is `c-<8 hex>` of its Lean's sha256, a test's `t-<8 hex>`, a question's `q-<n>`, an exhibit's `e-<8 hex>`
